title: Cross-team coupling catalog and cutover simulation
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a canonical cross-team coupling catalog (matrix of features -> teams -> required artifacts) plus a lightweight cutover simulation harness. Purpose: surface brittle handoffs early, quantify coupling risk for each initiative in Q2, and produce an executable cutover playbook that teams can run in a scheduled simulation window before rollout.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical coupling catalog CSV is published with entries for all Q2 initiatives that have cross-team touchpoints (eng, design, infra, security)
Coupling scores (0-10) computed for each initiative with rationale and owner assigned
At least two cutover simulation runs completed involving Eng+Design+Infra+Security for high-coupling initiatives, with runbook updates captured
Runbook includes checklist items, rollback criteria, observable KPIs, and per-team contact list
Post-simulation action items are triaged into Linear with owners and target dates
activity: 2026-02-20 — Created ticket. Brief: propose coupling catalog + simulation; initial ask from Exec: reduce cutover incidents by 40% in Q2. (Ava Martinez)

2026-02-25 — Scoping meeting with ENG/Design/Security leads. Decided catalog columns: initiative, feature owner, dependent teams, infra changes, migration window, observability signals, estimated coupling score, blocker severity. (Omar Malik)

2026-03-02 — Draft catalog spreadsheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abc-xyZ) shared with teams for data population. Action: teams to fill rows by 2026-03-09. (Design request noted: need wireframes for UX-affecting flows).
2026-03-05 — Engineering flagged a blocker: infra schema migration for runtime-1.18 will require DB migration sequence. Added ENG-3055 as dependency. (Lead: Priya Kaur)

2026-03-08 — Security reviewed catalog template; recommended adding compliance gating column and KMS key rotation impact. Marked security_review_required=false but added checklist items. (Luis Ortega, Security)

2026-03-10 — First dry-run simulation scheduled for 2026-03-18. Scope: Feature 'KV-cache prefixing v2' (ENG-1842) + console route change; participants: Eng, Infra, Design, Security, SRE. Meeting invite sent and runbook draft attached to Confluence (https://confluence.redwood.com/display/RMAP/Cutover+Sim+Runbook). (Omar Malik)

2026-03-11 — Design provided mockups for fallback UX and acceptance criteria added to catalog. Noted trade-off: tight rollout window increases coupling score for UX-dependent features. (Nina Patel, Design)

2026-03-12 — Populated preliminary coupling scores for 7 Q2 initiatives. Average coupling score across Q2 initiatives: 6.1/10. High coupling drivers: infra migrations, schema changes, and auth/KMS updates. Next: run simulation and capture telemetry. (Ava Martinez)
notes: Trade-offs discussed: enforce longer dark-launch windows to reduce incidents vs. business need for faster feature unlocks; proposal: three-tiered rollout policy based on coupling score (0-3 low, 4-6 medium, 7-10 high)
Simulation harness will replay a set of synthetic traffic patterns against staging with feature flags toggled; required infra quota for parallel runs requested from Dedicated team

Links: PRD for coupling catalog spec https://drive.google.com/file/d/PRD-coupling-spec, Confluence runbook https://confluence.redwood.com/display/RMAP/Cutover+Sim+Runbook, GH skeleton for simulator https://github.com/redwood-inference/cutover-sim/pull/47

Risks: missing ownership for cross-team migrations (we will add owners as mandatory field in the catalog), dependency resolution time often exceeds sprint boundaries—plan to include contingency windows in release calendar
next_steps: Complete data population in catalog by 2026-03-15 (owners: all squad leads)
Run first simulation on 2026-03-18; capture KPIs (error-rate, p95 latency, rollback latency)
Write follow-up action tickets from simulation results and assign owners within 48 hours
Finalize rollout gating policy and publish to Console operations docs by 2026-03-26
